findings.title: Survodutide in adults with obesity and MASLD: SYNCHRONIZE-MASLD, phase 3 (Nature Medicine)
findings.whatChanged: FIRST PUBLISHED PHASE 3 RESULT. Dossier (lastUpdated 2026-01-22) cites Breakthrough Therapy designation for MASH and "Phase 3 programmes" only. ESTIMAND-CRITICAL: weight change TREATMENT-REGIMEN -8.7% vs -1.4% placebo; efficacy estimand -12.2% vs -1.0%. LFC >=30% reduction: treatment-regimen 68.5% vs 28.6%; efficacy estimand 84.2% vs 24.3%. Lead with the treatment-regimen figures. n=216, 48 weeks. DOI 10.1038/s41591-026-04479-3, NCT06632457 and NCT06632444.
